body: Java2D correction now passes all 38 affected module tests. Final regression fails on original 25b56e8 renderer (italic j extends 9 pixels beyond the plate at BottomLeft); fixed version uses logical/visual bounds union without changing text anchors. Independent plate/ink tests cover 5 labels, 9 anchors, pinned italic and missing-family fallback (90 cases). Running repository-wide tests, docs and compatibility before candidate handoff. Please retain text plate in review; your broad tightness claim on Java2D required this correction.
